Messages.Author: Blooded Sand
Messages.Body:
Abactor
Type: Action
+1 stealth hunt action.
Gain 5 blood. After successful resolution, a referendum is called to
call a blood hunt on this vampire (independent of the action, just as
if he or she had committed diablerie).

May a vampire with the blood curse use Abactor to hunt?

Messages.Author: Chris Berger
Messages.Body:


Blood Curse prohibits diablerie. Is Abactor diablerie? No.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Correct, the vampire with a blood curse can hunt with Abactor.
If the action succeeds, a blood hunt is called.
